children: Acadia announced Phase 3-enabling Phase 2 topline results for remlifanserin in Alzheimer’s disease psychosis, with 60 mg showing nominal significance on CGI-S and favorable safety.
60 mg once-daily remlifanserin: SAPS-H+D change -12.6 vs -10.4 placebo at week 6; effect size 0.26 (p=0.0603), narrowly missing primary endpoint.
Key secondary CGI-S-ADP: 60 mg change -1.3 vs -0.9 placebo at week 6; effect size 0.37 (p=0.0077, nominal), showing statistical signal.
30 mg dose showed minimal improvement versus placebo; company will remove 30 mg arm from Phase 3 program.
Safety profile favorable across doses: adverse events, serious events, discontinuations similar to placebo; no QT signal, no deaths, no motor/cognition worsening observed.
Acadia will continue enrolling two ongoing Phase 3 studies, present detailed RADIANT Phase 2 data at CTAD Nov 16–19, 2026, and holds conference call/webcast.

title: Acadia reports Phase 3-enabling Phase 2 topline for remlifanserin in AD psychosis; 60 mg shows nominal CGI-S significance
